craft_notes: Sthāyin: utsāha at willed-measure — tenderness (vatsa) inside rigor. Feast-abiding: limitation-feast (utsava at limit); thought-free close. Rejected: (a) feast→state → killed: feast relishes. Read aloud: KNOW-er — JUST-this-FASH-ioned … KNOW-ing-SELF.

lines: Knower — just this fashioned — at limitation's feast undistracted stays —
